completion.plan.intro: Tab completion for {shell}. Smith writes these files and changes nothing else:
completion.plan.new: new file, only smith writes it
completion.plan.add: smith adds one marked line to your file
completion.plan.replace: smith rewrites what it wrote before
completion.plan.undo: To remove it again, run: smith completion uninstall
completion.ask.question: Write these files?
completion.ask.show.hint: print the script, then ask again
completion.ask.never.hint: you can still run: smith completion install
completion.offer.question: Set up tab completion for {shell}?
completion.offer.declined: Understood. Smith does not ask again. To set it up later, run: smith completion install
completion.offer.later: Smith asks again in two weeks.
completion.next.bash: Open a new terminal to use it.
completion.next.zsh: Open a new terminal to use it.
completion.next.fish: Open a new terminal to use it.
completion.next.powershell: Open a new PowerShell window to use it. If PowerShell blocks the profile, run: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned
completion.packaged:
Tab completion for {shell} already comes with your smith package: {path}
Smith changes nothing.
completion.already: Tab completion for {shell} is already set up. Smith changes nothing.
completion.nothing_to_remove: Tab completion from smith is not installed. There is nothing to remove.
completion.remove.intro: Smith removes its marked block from these files:{files}
completion.remove.question: Remove it?
completion.status.stale: - the script is from another smith: run smith completion install
completion.status.answer.none: Smith has not asked about tab completion yet.
completion.status.answer.no: You said no to the offer. Smith does not ask again.
completion.status.answer.later: You asked to be asked later.
completion.error.unknown_shell: {shell} is not a shell that smith completes in
completion.error.pass_shell: pass --shell bash, zsh, fish or powershell
completion.error.no_shell: smith cannot tell which shell you use
completion.error.no_home: smith cannot find your home folder
completion.error.set_home: set HOME (USERPROFILE on Windows) and run it again
completion.error.foreign: {path} exists and smith did not write it
completion.error.move_away: move or delete that file, then run this again
completion.error.cannot_ask: this needs your answer, and there is no terminal to ask in
completion.error.pass_yes: run it in a terminal, or pass --yes to confirm

commands.describe.completion.title: Set up tab completion
commands.describe.completion.why: Smith adds the completion script to your shell. The files and lines are listed first.
tui.completion.working_out_the_files: Working out which files to write. Nothing is changed.
